name: Polonius
message: Only last night, we discussed this. Why did I see Hamlet coming out of your chambers?

name: Polonius
message: Did nothing I say stick with you? Were you deceiving me?

name: Polonius
message: And he was half clothed, too. If only someone else had seen him dashing out like that... I shudder to think of it.

name: Polonius
message: I'm going to have to speak to the King about this. I cannot hide this from him. Unless, I suppose, you can offer some explanation for this transgression!

name: Ophelia
message: I'm sorry, Father. I don't feel well. I had such an odd vision last night--

name: Ophelia
message: No. Never mind it. It's passed now. I'll sleep better this evening, I think.

name: Polonius
message: Be careful, love. That's all I ask. Carrying on like this--it terrifies me. I don't want you hurt.
